question: The free_tier.unit vocabulary has no term for a unit of messages or notifications. Firebase Cloud Messaging is priced per message with no count cap, so the draft records unit as unlimited and names the true unit (messages per minute) in free_tier.notes. Should a messages or notifications unit be added to the schema?
why: The closed unit set cannot express a no-cost per-message push transport; forcing a byte or object unit would misstate the offer.

new.slice: The free_tier.unit vocabulary has no term for a unit of messages or notification
